# GameArena Partner API — llms.txt

Integration spec for third-party games (e.g. BlockSlide) plugging into GameArena.
GameArena is the distribution + identity layer. You keep your game, your contract,
your rewards, and your own player names. The WALLET is the shared join key: the same
wallet is the same player on both sides, whichever site they joined through.

## Base
- Base URL: https://game-backend-production-6130.up.railway.app
- Auth: header `x-partner-key: <YOUR_KEY>` on every request. GameArena issues one key
  per game. Keep it server-side. Never ship it in client code.
- Content-Type: application/json
- Rate limit: 120 requests / minute / key.
- Wallet format: 0x + 40 hex chars.

## Identity model (read this first)
- A player can join through YOUR site (you give them a name) or through GameArena
  (they get a GamePass name). You do not adopt each other's usernames.
- You already have the player's name + wallet from your own signup. Send BOTH with
  every score. That is all "getting their name" requires on your side.
- GameArena stores the name you send per wallet, so a player who never minted a
  GamePass still shows up NAMED on GameArena's boards (not a bare address).
- To greet a GameArena player by their GamePass name inside your game, call /profile.

## Endpoints

### POST /api/partner/score
Record a score onto GameArena. Call from YOUR server when a run ends.
Request body:
  {
    "wallet":  "0x...",        // required, the player's wallet
    "score":   41280,          // required, integer >= 0
    "name":    "neo",          // optional but RECOMMENDED — the player's name on your side
    "txHash":  "0x..."         // optional — your on-chain proof of the run
  }
Response 200:
  {
    "success": true,
    "game":    "blockslide",
    "onchain": true,           // true if GameArena also mirrored the score on-chain
    "txHash":  "0x..."         // the GameArena on-chain tx hash if onchain=true, else your txHash/null
  }
Notes:
- Best score per wallet is kept automatically. Lower scores still log activity.
- `name` is capped at 32 chars and sanitised. Send it whenever you have it.
- If GameArena has set your game up as an on-chain partner, this call also records
  the score on-chain on GameArena (GameArena sponsors the gas). Your own game and
  settlement are never touched.

### GET /api/partner/profile/:wallet
Resolve a wallet's GameArena identity. Use for "the same player on both sides".
Response 200:
  {
    "wallet":   "0x...",
    "hasPass":  true,          // does this wallet own a GameArena GamePass
    "username": "neo",         // their GamePass name, or null
    "verified": true,          // GoodDollar proof-of-humanity
    "joinUrl":  "https://gamearenahq.xyz"  // send here if hasPass=false to mint one
  }
Use: if hasPass, greet them by username. If not, offer joinUrl (they become a
GameArena user — good for both of us).

### GET /api/partner/verified/:wallet
GoodDollar proof-of-humanity only. Use to gate rewards or show a verified badge.
Response 200: { "wallet": "0x...", "verified": true }

### GET /api/partner/leaderboard?limit=20
Read your game's board back from GameArena. limit 1-100 (default 20).
Response 200:
  {
    "game": "blockslide",
    "rows": [
      { "rank": 1, "wallet": "0x...", "username": "neo", "score": 41280 }
      // username = the name you sent, else their GamePass name, else null
    ]
  }

## Errors
- 401 { "error": "missing partner key" }   — no x-partner-key header
- 403 { "error": "invalid partner key" }   — unknown/disabled key
- 400 { "error": "invalid wallet" | "invalid score" }
- 429 — rate limited (120/min/key)
- 5xx { "error": "..." } — transient, safe to retry

## Minimal integration (Node, server-side)
```js
const BASE = "https://game-backend-production-6130.up.railway.app";
const KEY  = process.env.GAMEARENA_KEY; // your partner key, server-side only

async function ga(path, opts = {}) {
  const r = await fetch(BASE + path, {
    ...opts,
    headers: { "x-partner-key": KEY, "content-type": "application/json", ...(opts.headers || {}) },
  });
  const body = await r.json().catch(() => ({}));
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`GameArena ${r.status}: ${body.error || r.statusText}`);
  return body;
}

// When a BlockSlide run ends — send wallet + your player's name + score:
await ga("/api/partner/score", {
  method: "POST",
  body: JSON.stringify({ wallet, score, name: playerName, txHash }),
});

// Optional: recognise a GameArena player inside BlockSlide:
const profile = await ga(`/api/partner/profile/${wallet}`);
if (profile.hasPass) greet(profile.username);
```

## Zero-dependency client
Copy sdk/gamearena.js (browser + Node 18+):
```js
import { GameArena } from "./gamearena.js";
const arena = new GameArena({ apiKey: process.env.GAMEARENA_KEY });
await arena.submitScore(wallet, score, { name, txHash });
const p = await arena.profile(wallet);
const board = await arena.leaderboard(20);
```
